metadata.title: That 2 kill moment where I forgot to aim but Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just stumble into a 2 kill spree?
Enemy must’ve been on a coffee break.
Click if your aim’s asleep but kills keep dropping!
Valorant logic strikes again.
